environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2 in a public subnet with the legacy monolith. gRPC port 50051 is exposed via NLB with no L7 inspection. IMDSv1 is enabled (default). No network policy restricts outbound from the instance. Security group allows inbound on 50051 from 0.0.0.0/0. The service runs as ec2-user with standard IAM instance profile attached (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/legacy-monolith-role).
